about: ASSET-001 early repaint recipe (troll_repaint.py). Mask = kit/repaint/troll_hive_mask.png in the Troll Body's UV0 (R bark, G extremity darkening, B blight veins = emission, A dark roots + mouth). Colours are linear multipliers applied to the texture's stored (sRGB-encoded) texel values, as the runtime reads them back with GetPixels. The vanilla luminance is kept everywhere (lum / mean lum), so the anatomy still reads.
bark_texture: olivetree_trunk01 (TheHive_Mat _MainTex), triplanar in rest-pose metres, tile 1.2 m
blight_emission: BlightGlow, driven by the biome tint at runtime
uv_note: the Troll's UVs are mostly mirrored, so the paint is symmetric

moss.how: albedo = lerp(albedo, moss_colour x vanilla luminance, R)
